layout.body:
Hi everyone,
Just a quick update about our long-awaited trip this Friday afternoon (June 21). We’ll meet at Riverside Park’s West Gate at 2:00 P.M.. Please send an email to Tom by this Wednesday to confirm your attendance. We’ll have a discussion after the trip. This is your chance to shine!
Don’t forget to:
• Wear comfy shoes (we’ll cover 3+ miles!);
• Bring reusable water bottles – let’s go green;
• Pack a rain jacket – weather’s been up in the air lately.
Please double-check the task list so that everyone can be on the same page.
Questions? Swing by my desk before Thursday. Let’s make this unforgettable!
Cheers,
Alex Chen
Team Coordinator

questions.stem: What does the phrase "on the same page" most likely mean?

options.A: Sitting in the same physical location
options.C: Reading the same page of the list

questions.analysis: What does the phrase "on the same page" most likely mean? 原文：Please double-check the task list so that everyone can be on the same page. on the same page 是英语常用习语，意思是达成共识、信息一致、有共同理解，不是指坐在同一个地方或看同一页书。 B：有共同的理解 → 正确

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the weather forecast for Friday?
questions.analysis: What can be inferred about the weather forecast for Friday? 原文：Pack a rain jacket – weather’s been up in the air lately. up in the air = 悬而未决、无法预测、不稳定。所以天气是 ** unpredictable（不可预测的）**。 C：情况不可预测 → 正确

questions.stem: What must team members do by Wednesday?

options.A: Meet at Riverside Park’s West Gate

questions.analysis: What must team members do by Wednesday? 原文：Please send an email to Tom by this Wednesday to confirm your attendance. 要求周三前给 Tom 发邮件确认出席。 C：向 Tom 确认出席 → 正确
